body.name: Specialized rational branch-tree certificate
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Cert}=(S^{\star},v^{\star},\mathcal T)\) contains an incumbent \(S^{\star}\in\mathcal P_k\), only a claimed rational incumbent value \(v^{\star}\), and a rooted binary tree \(\mathcal T\). The root is \((\varnothing,\mathcal C,\varnothing)\); every node label \((I,E,O)\) partitions \(\mathcal C\); and every internal node chooses \(c\in E\) and has exactly the two children \((I\cup\{c\},E\setminus\{c\},O)\) and \((I,E\setminus\{c\},O\cup\{c\})\). A leaf is justified either by \(|I|>k\) or by the exact optimistic-descendant bound \(\overline W(I\cup E)\geq v^{\star}\). The map \(\mathsf{Check}\) independently recomputes \(\overline W(S^{\star})\) and requires equality to \(v^{\star}\); it verifies incumbent feasibility, the root, every partition, both branch children of every internal node, every leaf justification, and exhaustive branch coverage in exact rational arithmetic. Neither \(D^{\star}\) nor a global-optimality assertion occurs in \(\mathsf{Cert}\).
